steps.title: Prepare 1 % Triton solution
steps.instruction: Mix 50 µL Triton X‑100 with 49.5 mL 1× PBS to obtain 1 % (v/v) Triton X‑100; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 4 % PFA solution
steps.instruction: Dilute 12.5 mL of 16 % PFA into 37.5 mL 1× PBS to obtain 4 % PFA; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 10 % BSA solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 5 g BSA in 50 mL 1× PBS to make 10 % (w/v) BSA; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis buffer (100 µL)
steps.instruction: Combine 79 µL 1 % Triton (from step 1), 10 µL 10× PhosSTOP, 10 µL 10× PIC, and 1 µL 100 mM PMSF; bring volume to 100 µL with water; keep on ice and use immediately.

steps.title: Prepare 10× Tris‑Gly‑SDS buffer (4 L)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 121.1 g Tris base, 576 g Glycine, and 200 g SDS in ddH₂O; adjust volume to 4 L with ddH₂O; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 20× TBS (4 L)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 193.6 g Tris base and 640 g NaCl in ddH₂O; bring volume to 4 L; adjust pH to 7.6 with HCl; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare TBST (1 L)
steps.instruction: Dilute 50 mL 20× TBS to 1 L with ddH₂O, add 1 mL Tween‑20 (0.1 % final); store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 5 % Milk in TBST (100 mL)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 5 g dry milk in 100 mL TBST; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Basal medium (500 mL)
steps.instruction: Mix 485 mL DMEM/F‑12, 5 mL 1× MEM non‑essential amino acids, 5 mL 1× GlutaMAX, 5 mL 1× Penicillin‑Streptomycin, and 1.93 µL 2‑Mercaptoethanol (55 µM final); filter‑sterilize and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Neural Induction Medium (NIM, 50 mL)
steps.instruction: Combine 50 mL Basal medium, 108 µL insulin (25 µg/mL), 25 µL SB431542 (10 µM), 6.25 µL LDN‑193189 (250 nM), and 50 µL retinoic acid (100 nM); add small molecules fresh daily; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare N2 medium (50 mL)
steps.instruction: Combine 49.5 mL Basal medium, 500 µL N‑2 supplement (1×), 5 µL SAG (250 nM), and 50 µL retinoic acid (100 nM); add small molecules fresh daily; store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare DNase I reaction (10 µL per sample)
steps.instruction: In a sterile tube on ice mix 1 µL 10× DNase I reaction buffer, 0.2 µL RNase‑free DNase I, 2 µg RNA sample, and nuclease‑free H₂O to a final volume of 10 µL; keep on ice and use immediately.

steps.title: Prepare reverse transcription master mix (10 µL per sample)
steps.instruction: Combine 2 µL 10× RT buffer, 0.8 µL 25× dNTP mix, 2 µL 10× RT random primers, and MultiScribe™ reverse transcriptase (volume not specified) with nuclease‑free H₂O to 10 µL total; keep on ice and use immediately.

steps.title: Digest sgRNA backbone with BbsI
steps.instruction: In a sterile tube combine ~1 µg pSB‑BbsI‑sgRNA plasmid (Addgene #203359), 1 µL BbsI‑HF, 2 µL rCutSmart buffer, 1 µL Quick CIP, and water to 20 µL; incubate 37 °C for 1–3 h; purify digested backbone by PCR purification (22 bp fragment).

steps.title: Prepare sgRNA oligo insert
steps.instruction: Reconstitute sense and antisense oligos to 100 µM in ultrapure water; in a sterile tube mix 4 µL sense 100 µM, 4 µL antisense 100 µM, 4 µL T4 DNA ligase buffer, 1 µL PNK, and 27 µL ultrapure water; thermocycle: 37 °C 30 min, 95 °C 10 min, then 85 °C, 75 °C, 65 °C, 55 °C, 45 °C, 35 °C, 25 °C each for 1 min; dilute phosphorylated/annealed oligos 1:50 with water.

steps.title: Ligate backbone and insert
steps.instruction: Mix 75 ng purified backbone, 1 µL diluted annealed oligos, 2 µL T4 DNA ligase buffer, 1 µL T4 DNA ligase, and water to 20 µL; incubate 16 °C for 1 h.

steps.title: Transform ligation into competent E. coli
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL ligation mix to chemically competent DH5α cells; plate on LB agar with 100 µg/mL ampicillin (or 100 mg/mL carbenicillin); incubate overnight at 37 °C.

steps.title: Colony PCR and plasmid preparation
steps.instruction: Pick colonies, swirl each in PCR mix with forward primer (U6 promoter) and reverse primer (antisense oligo); also swirl in 100 µL LB broth for overnight culture; grow positive clones in 3–5 mL LB + 100 µg/mL ampicillin at 37 °C, 200 rpm for 16 h; extract plasmid DNA with Miniprep kit; verify BbsI sites by Sanger sequencing using U6 primer.

steps.title: Maintain H9 hESCs on Matrigel
steps.instruction: Coat 6‑well plates with 1.5 mL Matrigel (1 mg/24 mL DMEM/F‑12) overnight at 37 °C; change mTeSR1 daily; when >80 % confluent, wash with 1 mL gentle cell dissociation buffer, incubate 3–5 min at RT, aspirate, add 1 mL fresh buffer, scrape gently, resuspend in mTeSR1 as small clumps; split 1:6 onto new 6‑well plates; incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Day 0 CRISPRoff transfection (first transfection)
steps.instruction: Place 250 µL mTeSR1 + 1 µL 10 mM Y‑27632 in each well of a Matrigel‑coated 12‑well plate; in 200 µL Opti‑MEM add 0.75 µg SB100 transposase plasmid, 1.25 µg CRISPRoff plasmid, and 6 µL TransIT‑LT1; include a no‑DNA control; incubate 15 min at RT; add mixture to well; detach cells with 1 mL Accutase per well (6‑well plate) for 5 min at 37 °C; dilute with 2 mL DMEM/F‑12, triturate 2–5×, collect cells, centrifuge 200 × g 4 min RT; resuspend pellet in 1 mL mTeSR1 + 10 µM Y‑27632, count, dilute to 1.5 × 10⁶ cells/mL; add 500 µL cell suspension to each well containing transfection mix; incubate overnight 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Day 2 post‑transfection media change
steps.instruction: Aspirate media and replace with fresh mTeSR1 without Y‑27632.

steps.title: Day 4 passage and puromycin selection
steps.instruction: When cells reach 70‑80 % confluence, passage as described for maintenance; the next day add puromycin to mTeSR1 at 0.8 mg/mL (validated kill curve); feed daily with puromycin‑supplemented mTeSR1 for 14 days; after 14 days, maintain at half‑dose puromycin; optionally cryopreserve stable line.

steps.title: Day 0 sgRNA pool transfection (second transfection)
steps.instruction: Place 250 µL mTeSR1 + 1 µL 10 mM Y‑27632 in each well of a Matrigel‑coated 12‑well plate; in 200 µL Opti‑MEM add 1 µg SB100 plasmid, 1 µg sgRNA pool (plus non‑targeting control), 6 µL TransIT‑LT1; include a no‑DNA control; incubate 15 min RT; add to well; detach cells with 1 mL Accutase per well (6‑well plate) for 5 min at 37 °C; dilute with 2 mL DMEM/F‑12, triturate, collect, centrifuge 200 × g 4 min RT; resuspend in 1 mL mTeSR1 + 10 µM Y‑27632, count, dilute to 1.5 × 10⁶ cells/mL; add 500 µL cell suspension to each well; incubate overnight 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Day 2 post‑sgRNA media change
steps.instruction: Aspirate media and replace with fresh mTeSR1 without Y‑27632.

steps.title: Day 4 passage and hygromycin selection
steps.instruction: When cells reach 70‑80 % confluence, passage as before; the next day add hygromycin B to mTeSR1 at 60 mg/mL (validated kill curve); feed daily with hygromycin‑supplemented mTeSR1 for 14 days; thereafter maintain at half‑dose hygromycin and puromycin.

steps.title: Validate pluripotency and genome integrity
steps.instruction: Perform colony selection, karyotyping (KaryoStat+ assay), and cryopreserve stable hESC clones.

steps.title: MCL‑1 silencing assay setup
steps.instruction: Plate MCL‑1 and NT hESC lines on 6‑well Matrigel plates; set four groups: –DOX, +DOX, +DOX + QVD, +DOX + DMSO (vehicle); when 40‑50 % confluent, add mTeSR1 + antibiotics with 1 µg/mL doxycycline and/or 25 µM Q‑VD‑OPh as appropriate (Day 0).

steps.title: MCL‑1 silencing treatment duration
steps.instruction: Change media daily for 72 h (Days 1–2) maintaining same DOX/QVD concentrations; on Day 3 (72 h) collect cells.

steps.title: Cell harvest for RNA
steps.instruction: Wash cells once with 1× PBS; add 500 µL TRIzol per well; scrape cells, transfer to 1.5 mL tube; store at –80 °C or proceed to RNA isolation.

steps.title: RNA isolation (TRIzol method)
steps.instruction: Thaw frozen samples at RT ≥5 min; add 100 µL chloroform, shake 15 s, incubate RT 2–3 min; centrifuge 12,000 × g 15 min 4 °C; transfer aqueous phase to new tube; add 250 µL 2‑propanol, invert ~10×, incubate RT 25 min; centrifuge 12,000 × g 10 min 4 °C; discard supernatant, wash pellet with 500 µL 75 % ethanol, vortex briefly, centrifuge 10,000 × g 10 min 4 °C; remove ethanol, air‑dry pellet, resuspend in 30 µL DEPC‑treated water; store –80 °C.

steps.title: DNase I treatment of RNA
steps.instruction: On ice, set up per‑sample DNase I reaction (see step 12): 1 µL 10× DNase I buffer, 0.2 µL RNase‑free DNase I, up to 2 µg RNA, water to 10 µL; incubate 37 °C 10 min in thermocycler; add 0.5 µL 0.1 M EDTA, heat 75 °C 10 min to inactivate; RNA is now ready for reverse transcription.

steps.title: cDNA synthesis
steps.instruction: Prepare reverse transcription master mix (step 13); add 10 µL master mix to 10 µL DNase‑treated RNA (2 µg); vortex, spin, run thermocycler: 25 °C 10 min, 37 °C 120 min, 85 °C 5 min, hold 4 °C; dilute cDNA to 200 µL with 180 µL nuclease‑free water; use 5 µL cDNA per qPCR reaction.

steps.title: Quantitative RT‑PCR
steps.instruction: Set up qPCR on QuantStudio 3 using SYBR Green Master Mix, 5 µL cDNA, gene‑specific primers (MCL‑1 primers in Table S2); run per manufacturer’s program; analyze Ct values.

steps.title: Differentiation – Day ‑3 replating hESCs
steps.instruction: When hESCs are 70‑90 % confluent, aspirate medium, add 1 mL Accutase, incubate 37 °C 5 min; dilute with 2 mL DMEM/F‑12, triturate 2–5×, collect cells, centrifuge 200 × g 4 min RT; resuspend in 1 mL mTeSR1 + 10 µM Y‑27632, count; plate 8 × 10⁴ cells per well of Matrigel‑coated 6‑well plate.

steps.title: Day ‑2 and ‑1 hESC maintenance
steps.instruction: Day ‑2: aspirate and add fresh mTeSR1 to remove Y‑27632. Day ‑1: continue feeding with mTeSR1.

steps.title: Day 0 neural induction
steps.instruction: When colonies reach ~80 % confluence, aspirate medium, add Neural Induction Medium (NIM, step 9); change NIM daily until Day 8.

steps.title: Day 8 oligodendrocyte lineage induction
steps.instruction: Aspirate NIM, add N2 medium (step 10) to promote oligodendrocyte commitment.

steps.title: Day 9 replating neural precursors
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL Accutase, incubate 37 °C 5 min; dilute with 2 mL DMEM/F‑12, triturate, collect, centrifuge 200 × g 4 min RT; resuspend in 1 mL N2 medium + 10 µM Y‑27632, count; plate 1.5 × 10⁶ cells per well on Matrigel‑coated 6‑well plate (or 35 mm glass‑bottom dish for IF); supplement with 10 µM Y‑27632.

steps.title: Day 10 doxycycline induction
steps.instruction: Replace medium with N2 medium containing 1 µg/mL doxycycline; refresh daily with same doxycycline concentration.

steps.title: Day 14 harvest for analyses
steps.instruction: Collect cells for western blot, qRT‑PCR, and immunofluorescence as described below.

steps.title: Protein extraction for western blot
steps.instruction: Prepare lysis buffer (step 5) on ice (100 mL per 6‑well); aspirate media, wash once with 1× PBS, add 100 µL lysis buffer per well, scrape, transfer to 1.5 mL tube; incubate on ice 30 min, vortex every 10 min; centrifuge 14,000 × g 30 min 4 °C; collect supernatant, store –20 °C.

steps.title: Western blot sample preparation
steps.instruction: Determine protein concentration (BCA assay); dilute 30 µg protein in 1 % Triton (step 1) and LDS sample buffer with 2‑Mercaptoethanol; heat 95 °C 5 min.

steps.title: SDS‑PAGE and transfer
steps.instruction: Load samples onto 4‑20 % Mini‑PROTEAN TGX gel; run in 10× Tris‑Gly‑SDS buffer (step 6); transfer proteins to PVDF membrane at 4 °C overnight.

steps.title: Immunoblotting
steps.instruction: Block membrane in 5 % milk in TBST (step 8) for 1 h RT on rocker; incubate with primary antibody (Table S3) overnight at 4 °C on rocker; wash TBST 5 min ×3; incubate with HRP‑conjugated secondary antibody 1 h RT; wash TBST 5 min ×3; develop with ECL Plus, image on chemiluminescent imager; quantify bands with Image Studio Lite.

steps.title: Immunofluorescence staining
steps.instruction: Fix cells with 4 % PFA in 1× PBS for 20 min RT; permeabilize with 1 % Triton (step 1) for 10 min RT; block with 10 % BSA (step 3) in 1× PBS for 1 h RT; incubate with primary antibody (Table S3) diluted in 10 % BSA overnight 4 °C; wash 1× PBS three times; incubate with secondary antibody diluted in 10 % BSA for 1 h RT; wash 1× PBS three times; incubate with Hoechst 33342 for 10 min; wash 1× PBS; mount with Fluoromount‑G; image on confocal microscope.

description: Validation of protocol We validated the use of this protocol by silencing MCL-1, an anti-apoptotic protein, at an early state of oligodendrocyte differentiation in vitro. MCL-1 is required for the survival of hPSCs in vitro and thus needs to be silenced after the initiation of the differentiation process. All experiments presented have been replicated using three or more technical replicates and at least three biological replicates. Controls included NT sgRNAs.
